name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates detail in flat or low-contrast areas without blowing out edges—critical for excavator footage where textures blur under motion or dust. The trade-off is heavier GPU load; we accept slower batch processing to gain sharper outputs where it matters most.

name: Torque
text: Depth maps won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core issue is the u-net’s face-refiner node failing under motion blur—depth won’t recover what the model already discards. Instead, test SD3.5-Ultr’s new face-refiner node first; if it fails, switch to a dedicated face-restoration model like CodeFormer or GFPGAN before adding heavier upscalers. Settle it by running a blind A/B test on 50 excavator clips with faces: measure face fidelity drop vs. GPU load.
